//: Services MAIC can install for itself. Submodules are pinned to stable tags or commits; a release is a binary download verified against its published checksum. `maic vendor` reads this.

comfyui.description: ComfyUI in its own Python (uv, 3.13, CUDA 13 torch), API nodes and auto-launch off, models on the external drive, MAIC's llama.cpp chat nodes linked in

llamacpp.description: llama.cpp built out of tree (CUDA when nvcc is present, no TLS so nothing can be downloaded), llama-server on 127.0.0.1:8081 serving the GGUF that `maic vendor use llamacpp PATH` picks

ollama.description: Ollama server, official Linux build, run local-only by services/ollama.json (no cloud, no remotes)
